entities.name: Vincentius Sensi Potokota
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vincentius Sensi Potokota was an Indonesian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church who served as the eighth archbishop of the Archdiocese of Ende from 2007 to his death in 2023. Previously, he served as the first bishop of the Diocese of Maumere from 2006 to 2007.
